rules.quote: Don’t use full stops with contractions or most abbreviations.

rules.quote:
Don’t use full stops in:

headings
stand-alone lists (stand-alone lists have a heading without a colon)
page headers or footers.
rules.violation_condition: a full stop at the end of a heading, a stand-alone list item, or a page header/footer
rules.why: Groups prohibited structural elements for terminal full stops.

covers.quote: symbols or units of measurement (unless the symbol or unit is also at the end of a sentence)

rules.quote:
Full stops do not go after:

symbols or units of measurement (unless the symbol or unit is also at the end of a sentence)
captions and titles.
rules.violation_condition: a full stop placed after a symbol or unit of measurement (not at the end of a sentence), or at the end of a caption or title
when: Exception: a full stop is allowed after a symbol or unit of measurement if it also ends a sentence.
rules.why: Prohibits full stops after measurements/captions/titles with a stated exception (G-2).

rules.why: Defines full stop punctuation specifically for SMS messages (G-2, G-4).
